title: British American aids his country during US Army Hurricane response
description: PFC Bill Foster, a motor transport operator with the 101st Sustainment Brigade, worked along side North Carolina National Guard members as part of various high water rescue missions during the US Army response to Hurricane Florence in North Carolina, September, 2018.
